content: Xianxin Gieku
Xianxin giekushi xiwon giesan shiqinni bawo wo, chanla daku shiqinni ghanghanaghakui wo.
Eneghala Huda eqighanku kunlai renjizho.
Xianxin giekughala matan alanshi Hudai kielienyi tungo giezhi zhayaghasei mejiene. Ingiezhi chanlasanshi chanla dakuse zhayaghasan wo.

Xianxin giekughala Hhabi Hudade sidagha giesan Jiabi giesanse gou wo. Hhei xianxin giekughala Huda mureini jienliezhi Hhabishi gou kun wo giezhi renjiwo. Hhe fuguzhoma, xianxin giekughala edeliuzhe kielien kieliezho.

Xianxin giekughala Idileisii jienlie echise hhe fugukui jingo ese giewo. Kunla hhei ereizhi olu dakushi Huda hhei jienlie echizho. Hhei jienlie echiku melie hhe Hudai bayasughase gou minshenyi jienliewo.
Xianxin gieku wise Hudai bayasugha dane. Hudai melie irechen kun ijinyo Huda winekui xianxin giezhi hhei ereisan kunlade jianli ogikui xianxin giekui wo.

Xianxin giekughala Nuhha chanla dasan shiqinni Huda jingao giese zunjizhi fugie chonni zhunbei giedene giei kunlaini man jiuiwo. Xianxin giekughala Nuhha hhe idai kunlai zuini jinjiwo, goyai Hudai melie gounide sanawo.
Huda Iburaheimui urukude hhe xianxin giekughala minlinyi zunjizhi jianlai caichan gieku oronde khizhewoma, echikude khala echikui ulie mejiene.
Hhe xianxin giekughala dain giesan oronde soukude kunlai oronde souku mutun zhanfande souzho. Niekielienji dain giesei jienliesan Isaghei, Yagebuye qingiezho.
Eneshi hhe Huda jihua giezhi beighasan jichutu chenshii sagheizho.
Xianxin giekughala Sare kewosi laiku nasunse daoliuzhe kewosi laizho. Hhe sumulase hhende dain giesan hhe kekao wo giezho.
Ingiese hoxian nie fugusan kunse houdei oluzhi asiman jieredu hodun, haibienzini shazi mutun shuzi uwo.

Enezighan kunlade man xianxin gieku bizhi fuguwoma, dain giesei jienlie dazho. Gholose dain giesei chanladene bayasuzhi jienliene giezho. Pse goyalane duya jieredu toreichen, zhanshi sousan kun wo giezhi chenren giezho.
Intui kieliechen kunshi minminji goyadene nie gojia ereizho.
Hhela likai giesan oronne sumulazhoshi khareizhi echiku jihui winema,
hhela hende xiwon giesanshi nie genjia gou gojia, jiushi asiman jieredu wo. Hhela Hudai Huda giese Huda shizhene ulie giedene hhelade nie chenshini zhunbei giezho.
Xianxin giekughala Iburaheimui Huda shiikude Isagheini khughozhi ogiwo. Dain giesei jienliesan kun goya niekozi kewonneliuzhe khughozhi ogiwo.
Ene kewonni kieliese Huda kieliezhi daozho, "Zinie Isagheise olusei chii houdei giezhi urune."
Hhe sumulase Huda kunni fugusan kun dundase aminne olughane giezho. Hoxian hhe fugusan kun dundase kewonne uduru irewo.
Xianxin giekughala Isaghei jianlaiku shiqinde oluzhi Yagebu, Isaode onxian giewo.
Xianxin giekughala Yagebu fugukude Yusufuni kewonlade nienieji onxian giezhi zhugun tuludene Hudai beiiwo.
Xianxin giekughala Yusufu fugukude Isilie kunla jianlai Aijise khizhekui kieliezhi pse goya yasunyi matui chuli giekui fenfulawo.
Musai oluse ada, anani uzhese nie seighan kewosi wo. Xianxin giekughala honshanni minlinse ese ayizhi ghuran sara niuighawo.
Xianxin giekughala Musa fugiedadene Falaoni oqinde kewon ulie danlane giezho.
Khareidene Hudai bexinlare hhantu shouku gieliuzhe zui dunda zhanshi xianshou ulie giene.
Hhe Mexihade oluzhi uru giesei uzhedan Aijini boubeise gundude uzhezho. Hhe jianlaiku jianlini sagheizho.
Xianxin giekughala hhe honshan hokukuse ese ayizhi Aijise likai giewo. Chanla daku Ezhanyi hoxian chanlaku mutun rennai giezho.
Xianxin giekughala hhe Jiulidaosan Jie, chusun xireighaku kuichenni jinjiwo. Ingiezhi hhe alachen irese Isilie kunlai fugie kewonlai ese alaghazho.
Xianxin giekughala Isilie kunla Hunhaini daokude khosun oron daoku niekielien wo. Aiji kunla qingiezhi shiizhi daokude yenji alawo.
Xianxin giekughala Isilie kunla Yelige chenshini doludu rouise chenqian furawo.
Xianxin giekughala biozi Lahe tewulai goude jienliedene hhezighan ese shunjisan kunlare hhantu ese fuguwo.
Bi pse yan kieliene? Jijien, Balake, Cansun, Yefuta, Dawude, Samuer, pse xienzhilai shiqinni nienieji kieliese shijie ulie kune.
Xianxin giekughala hhela gojialai hanshiliewo, gundanni giewo, dain giesei jienliewo, shizini amanyi duighawo,
fugie khanni tuliekui widaghawo, khudogho renzise holu andawo, zholiennise khidunnii gholuwo, zhan eghikude lihaishiwo, niman kunlai buduilai man eghi tuighawo.
Biereila fugusan dundase aminne olusan giene kunyi jienliewo. Niezhan kunla genjia gou fuhoni jienliene giezhi hende tendun shouizhi andaku duran uwo.
Niezhan kunlai xilun gie, mabienzida, banla, kha,
tashida ala, qiroujie ala, khudoghoghala alawo. Ghoni, iman arasunyi zhozhi gochude holu, nanxin duru, heikui shoui, zayala,
hontan, ula, dun, nokiende liulan giezho. Ene duya hhelai pei dane.
Enezighan kunla xianxin giekui tungo giezhi gou minshenyi jienliewoma, dain giesei jienlie dawo.
Eneshi Huda matande genjia gou shiqin zhunbei giezho. Matan uwoshi hhela hulunshi dane.
